timings.text: Welcome to Humanverse, the authentic professional network designed for the real, unpolished parts of career life. Here is how to use Humanverse.
First, explore the live feed. Read honest career stories, and react with empathy using badges like Been there, Respect, or Needed this.
Next, creating a post. When sharing sensitive topics like compensation or layoffs, toggle the Pseudonym switch for complete privacy and zero employment risk.
Explore dedicated Career Threads. Jump into Laid Off, Rejected Again, or Career Pivot to exchange actionable advice and solidarity with peers.
Need guidance or want to give back? Use the Help marketplace to request resume audits, mock interviews, and find mentorship without paywalls.
Finally, join niche Circles for your domain, and use your private Career Journal to reflect on daily milestones and personal growth.
Work is human, and your network should be too. Start your authentic journey on Humanverse today at humanverse.fun.
